I don't have any current suite deals or weekend rates on hand, so I won't guess at a discount. The front desk keeps the live rates and any offers, and I'm happy to check with them for you.

It's also worth knowing that cancellation is free up to 48 hours before arrival. After that, the charge is one night's rate. Check-in is at 15:00 and check-out at 11:00, and you can ask for late check-out until 14:00 if it's available.

Would you like me to ask the front desk about suite deals for this weekend? I can also start a suite booking for Friday to Sunday right away.

Your harbor cruise form is still open whenever you're ready to add the number of guests.
